domain: cairn/devices/cairn (device); cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle (machine held by device cairn)
intent: The cairn device's sleep cycle follows outline 5.3.3: the clock (23:00 local) is sleep's base trigger and measured interaction overrides it, so a pulse that cannot read every activity source sleeps at the clock instead of never; and at its time Cairn runs its own sleep first, then hands the token round the rack (5.3.3.1, 5.7.3.3).
scope: in: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/idle.py, cairn/devices/cairn/device.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/proofs/test_the_clock_is_the_base_trigger.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/proofs/test_idle_trigger.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/intention+why.json; out: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/token.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py, cairn/tools/base/shim.py (the 5.9 scheduler list and the 5.8.3.5 shim wake-and-pass are the base shim's), cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop, cairn/devices/cairn/logs_sweep.py
